newsitem.title: USA: Black Hawk stake taken by Cleveland group.
newsitem.headline: Black Hawk stake taken by Cleveland group.

text.p: A group including Diversified Opportunities Group Ltd, a Cleveland, Ohio,-based investment firm, said Friday it has acquired the 7.1 percent stake in Black Hawk Gaming & Development Co Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought from Black Hawk 190,467 common shares on November 12 for $1.0 million.

On the same day, the group also bought a $1.5 million note from the company. The note is to be replaced by a $6 million note as soon as approval by shareholders of Black Hawk and regulators at the National Association of Securities Dealers is secured, according to the filing.
The note will then become convertible at the rate of $5.25 a share.
The group said that after it bought the shares and the $1.0 million note was issued, Jeffrey Jacobs, a trustee of Diversified, was named chief executive and co-chairman of the Black Hawk board.

When the note is converted and the group holds 820,000 shares, Black Hawk's board, currently consisting of seven members, will be expanded to nine and the group will be entitled to nominate five members, according to the filing.
